answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit that grows with its reputation, so creating thousands of fake identities becomes expensive in locked capital and time. A newcomer must first complete verifiable work in a shared sandbox, and its history cannot simply mirror another agent's record: identical behaviour across accounts triggers review. Trusted hosts can act as a haven only after proving long, consistent service, never as an isolated island of self-approval; peers cross-check claims before rewards flow, so a sybil farm pays far more than it can earn.
